title: MonthCalendar
description: A Monday-first month grid with per-day event counts, keyboard navigation and the selected day's events.

support.notes: Shared local-date core: Monday-first 42-day grid; controlled Date month and string selection/defaults; adjacent day navigation, today/year keys, localized headers and labels, event counts/clicks, display-only normalized ranges, size and day/event slots. Uni extensions: weekStartsOn, min/max and disabledDates. Keyboard metadata and native touch actions are implemented; device focus/geometry still require validation. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

translationResources.title: MonthCalendar
translationResources.description: A Monday-first month grid with per-day event counts, keyboard navigation and the selected day's events.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Select a day to list its events; arrows, Home / End and PageUp / PageDown (with Shift: a year) move the focus. Each day is a focusable grid cell marked aria-selected, so the selection is announced once.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: size="small" is a compact grid where events show as dots; size="large" is comfortable, with the day number at the top and the event badge at the bottom of a taller cell.

range.title: Highlighted range
range.description: rangeStart / rangeEnd tint the days in between and fill both ends (display only, in either order). Here a first click starts a new range and a second one closes it.

MonthCalendarProps.onMonthChange: Called with the first day of the requested month
MonthCalendarProps.events: Events; each day shows how many it has
MonthCalendarProps.onEventClick: Makes the selected day's events clickable
MonthCalendarProps.rangeStart: First day of a highlighted range (display only)
MonthCalendarProps.rangeEnd: Last day of a highlighted range (display only)
MonthCalendarProps.size: Cell density: compact (small), default (medium) or comfortable (large)
MonthCalendarProps.disabled: Blocks navigation, selection and event clicks
MonthCalendarProps.showSelectedDayEvents: Lists the selected day's events below the grid
MonthCalendarProps.todayLabel: Label of the button returning to the current month
MonthCalendarProps.getDayLabel: Accessible label of a day button (day, number of events)
MonthCalendarProps.getEventsLabel: Accessible label of the selected day's event list
MonthCalendarProps.emptyEventsText: Text shown when the selected day has no events

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: month ("YYYY-MM") and value ("YYYY-MM-DD") are attributes, events a property. One tab stop: arrows, Home / End and PageUp / PageDown move through the grid.

events.title: Events
events.description: minerva-change reports the selected day, minerva-month-change the displayed month; with clickable-events, minerva-event-click fires for an event.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: size="small" draws events as dots, size="large" gives taller cells with the day number at the top (also the :state(size-small) ... custom states).

range.title: Highlighted range
range.description: range-start / range-end highlight the days in between (display only); set them from minerva-change to build a range picker.

localized.title: Localization and states
localized.description: locale and the label attributes translate the calendar, weekdayLabels / getDayLabel / getEventsLabel are properties. Right: hide-events and disabled.

props.clickableEvents: Renders the selected day's events as buttons firing minerva-event-click.
props.hideEvents: Hides the list of the selected day's events (the React library's showSelectedDayEvents={false}).

events.minerva-change: The user selected a day (detail: { value }, "YYYY-MM-DD").
events.minerva-month-change: The user displayed another month (detail: { month }, its first day at local midnight).
events.minerva-event-click: An event of the selected day was activated (detail: { event }; requires clickable-events).
